task_completion.description: The Multiplanar Reconstruction (MPR) viewer interface is open and displaying the CT series.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A medical imaging interface showing orthogonal views (Axial, Sagittal, Coronal) of a CT scan.

task_completion.description: The rendering mode is set to Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dropdown menu, toggle, or label in the settings panel explicitly showing 'MIP' or 'Maximum Intensity Projection' as the active mode.

task_completion.description: The slab thickness is configured to at least 15mm.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A numerical input field or slider label for 'Thickness' or 'Slab' showing a value of 15 or higher (e.g., '15.0 mm').

task_completion.description: The agent captures a full-screen screenshot of the configured MPR view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot action or a file explorer window showing 'mip_slab_view.png' in the '~/DICOM/exports/' directory.

task_completion.description: The agent documents the parameters in the specified text file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing the creation/content of 'mpr_settings.txt' containing the MIP and thickness parameters.

integrity.description: The agent used the graphical user interface to configure the MPR settings rather than just creating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the mouse cursor interacting with the MPR settings panel or dropdown menus.

integrity.description: The visual appearance of the CT scan changes to reflect the MIP rendering and increased thickness.
integrity.visual_evidence: The CT images should appear brighter and show more vascular/bony structures merged together compared to a standard thin-slice view.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo text into a file without opening the medical imaging software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The presence of the medical imaging software window in the trajectory history before the file export.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a minimum slab thickness of 15mm. The expected export paths are /home/ga/DICOM/exports/mip_slab_view.png and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/mpr_settings.txt. The patient ID for the synthetic series is MPR001.
